import json, os, sys
# Plays the forge's issue store for A22 and the owner's replies: issue-list-open.json and issue-list-closed.json.
g = os.environ["CAMPAIGN_GH_DIR"]
cmd, repo = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
openf, closedf = os.path.join(g, "issue-list-open.json"), os.path.join(g, "issue-list-closed.json")


def issue(n, title, body="", labels=(), milestone=None, comments=(), kind="issues"):
    return {"number": n, "title": title, "body": body, "labels": None if labels is None else [{"name": x} for x in labels],
            "milestone": milestone, "assignees": [], "url": "https://example.invalid/%s/%s/%d" % (repo, kind, n),
            "createdAt": "2025-12-30T00:00:00Z", "comments": list(comments)}


def note(login, body, at="2025-12-31T00:00:00Z"):
    return {"author": {"login": login}, "body": body, "createdAt": at}


if cmd == "seed":
    card = "**Source:** %s#20\n**Failure class:** precheck-skip on a renamed path\n" % repo
    items = [issue(2, "Precheck skipped on a rename", card),
             issue(3, "Placed already", milestone={"title": "M1"}),
             issue(4, "Flavored already", comments=[note("sandbox-coordinator", "<!-- crew:v1 role=coordinator "
                                                         "pass=flavor issue=4 flavor=standard default=standard -->")]),
             issue(5, "Triage log 2025-12-31", labels=["triage:log"]),
             issue(6, "A pull request", kind="pull"),
             issue(7, "Recorded already", comments=[note("sandbox-coordinator", "<!-- crew:v1 role=researcher "
                                                         "pass=triage issue=7 decision=classify priority=P2 "
                                                         "mode=shadow sweep=20251231T0000Z -->")]),
             issue(8, "Something broke"),
             issue(9, "Crew stalls on every run", labels=["P0"]),
             issue(10, "Malformed item", labels=None)]
    items += [issue(n, "Feature request %s" % chr(86 + n), "Add option %d to crew status." % n) for n in range(11, 20)]
    json.dump(items, open(openf, "w"), indent=1)
    json.dump([{"number": 20, "title": "Precheck skip report", "body": card}], open(closedf, "w"), indent=1)
elif cmd == "own":
    items = json.load(open(openf))
    for i in items:
        if i["number"] == int(sys.argv[3]):
            i["comments"].append(note("sandbox-owner", sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5]))
    json.dump(items, open(openf, "w"), indent=1)
elif cmd == "new":
    items = json.load(open(openf))
    items += [issue(n, "Idea %d for the sandbox" % n, "A plain report %d." % n)
              for n in range(int(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]) + 1)]
    json.dump(items, open(openf, "w"), indent=1)

cat > {state_dir}/triage.py <<'PY'
import json, os, re, subprocess, sys
# Plays Riley's triage sweep (templates/runtimes/tmux/researcher.md Triage sweep) for a stub engine: no model.
# Shadow mode: records and proposals only. The fake forge keeps each post in issue-list-open.json.
repo, day, sweep, me, src = sys.argv[1:6]
st, gd = os.environ["CREW_STATE"], os.environ["CAMPAIGN_GH_DIR"]
brief = open(os.environ["CREW_BRIEF"]).read()
assert re.search(r"^- Item: triage sweep", brief, re.M)
status = open(os.environ["CREW_STATUS"], "a")
rec = json.load(open(os.path.join(st, "runs", os.environ["CREW_ID"] + ".json")))
who = "— 🔬 Riley (Researcher) · %s · %s\n" % (rec["harness"], rec["model"])
openf, closedf = os.path.join(gd, "issue-list-open.json"), os.path.join(gd, "issue-list-closed.json")
items, closed = json.load(open(openf)), json.load(open(closedf))
url = lambda n: "https://example.invalid/%s/issues/%s" % (repo, n)
LINE = re.compile(r"<!-- crew:v1 ([^>]*?) -->")
fields = lambda c: [dict(kv.split("=", 1) for kv in m.split() if "=" in kv) for m in LINE.findall(c["body"])]
item = lambda n: next(i for i in items if i["number"] == n)
clock = [0]


def save():
    json.dump(items, open(openf, "w"), indent=1)


def gh(*args):
    subprocess.run(["gh", *args, "-R", repo], check=True, capture_output=True)


def post(n, body):
    path = os.path.join(st, "runs", os.environ["CREW_ID"] + ".body.md")
    open(path, "w").write(body)
    gh("issue", "comment", str(n), "--body-file", path)
    clock[0] += 1
    item(n)["comments"].append({"author": {"login": me}, "body": body,
                                "createdAt": "%sT%s:%02d:%02dZ" % (day, sweep[-5:-3], clock[0] // 60, clock[0] % 60)})
    save()


def label(n, name):
    gh("issue", "edit", str(n), "--add-label", name)
    item(n)["labels"].append({"name": name})
    save()


def sign(n, outcome, band, body):
    return ("[Riley/triage] #%s: %s %s\n\n%s\n\n<!-- crew:v1 role=researcher pass=triage issue=%s decision=%s "
            "priority=%s mode=shadow sweep=%s -->\n%s") % (n, outcome, band, body, n, outcome, band, sweep, who)


logs = [i for i in items + closed if any(x["name"] == "triage:log" for x in i.get("labels") or [])]
calib = [f["sweep"] for i in logs for c in i.get("comments", []) for f in fields(c) if f.get("pass") == "triage-log"]
calibration = not calib
today = [f for i in logs if i["title"] == "Triage log " + day for c in i["comments"] for f in fields(c)
         if f.get("pass") == "triage-log"]
budget = None if calibration else 10 - sum(int(f.get("proposed", 0)) for f in today)
queue = json.load(open(os.path.join(st, "triage", "queue.json")))["items"]
applied, proposed, skipped, lines = 0, 0, 0, []
for e in sorted(queue, key=lambda e: (not e.get("p0"), e["ref"])):
    if "unreadable" in e:
        skipped += 1
        lines.append("- skipped: unreadable %s (%s)" % (e["ref"], e["unreadable"]))
        continue
    n = int(e["ref"].split("#")[1])
    it = item(n)
    if e["reason"] == "owner-feedback":
        last = max(k for k, c in enumerate(it["comments"]) if any(f.get("pass") == "triage" for f in fields(c)))
        reply = [c for c in it["comments"][last + 1:] if re.search(r"^triage: (accept|reject)", c["body"], re.M)][-1]
        m = re.search(r"^triage: (accept|reject) ?(.*)$", reply["body"], re.M)
        band = [f for f in fields(it["comments"][last]) if f.get("pass") == "triage"][0]["priority"]
        post(n, sign(n, "owner-%sed" % m[1].rstrip("e"), band, "Owner answer recorded: `%s`. Reason: %s\n"
                     "used: %s#answer (owner feedback)" % (m[0], m[2] or "none", url(n))))
        lines.append("- recorded owner answer on #%s" % n)
        continue
    if budget is not None and proposed >= budget:
        skipped += 1
        lines.append("- skipped: cap #%s" % n)
        continue
    if not e["card"] and not any(x["name"] == "triage:card-extracted" for x in it["labels"]):
        post(n, "[Riley/card] #%s\n\n```markdown\nSource: unknown\nFailure class: unknown\n```\n" % n)
        label(n, "triage:card-extracted")
    dup = [d for d in e["duplicates"] if d["state"] == "closed"]
    if e["p0"]:
        outcome, band, used = "classify", "P0", "%s (rule: %s)" % (url(n), ", ".join(e["p0"]))
    elif dup:
        outcome, band = "duplicate", "P2"
        used = ", ".join("%s (rule: exact keys %s)" % (url(d["ref"].split("#")[1]), " ".join(d["keys"])) for d in dup)
    else:
        outcome, band, used = "classify", "P2", "none"
    post(n, sign(n, outcome, band, "Applied: nothing (shadow)\nProposed: %s %s\nCooldown if rejected: %d days\nused: %s"
                 % (outcome, band, 30 if outcome == "duplicate" else 14, used)))
    label(n, "triage:proposed")
    proposed += 1
    lines.append("- proposed: %s #%s %s" % (outcome, n, band))
dump = os.path.join(st, "triage", "items-%s.json" % sweep)
json.dump(items + closed, open(dump, "w"))
metrics = "python3 %s/scripts/triage-metrics.py" % src
run = lambda cmd: subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
if calibration:
    lines.append("\nSpot check (owner: `triage: accept` or `triage: reject <reason>` on each):\n" +
                 run("%s sample --items %s --sweep %s" % (metrics, dump, sweep)))
else:
    bar = run("%s bar --items %s --sweep %s" % (metrics, dump, calib[0]))
    lines.append("\n" + bar)
    eval_path = os.path.join(st, "triage", "eval.json")
    if bar.endswith(": met") and not os.path.exists(eval_path):
        lines.append(run("%s eval-freeze --items %s --sweep %s --out %s" % (metrics, dump, calib[0], eval_path)))
        lines.append("The bar is met: the owner may set `mode = \"apply\"`; Riley never sets it.")
log = next((i for i in items if i["title"] == "Triage log " + day), None)
if not log:
    n = max(i["number"] for i in items + closed) + 1
    gh("issue", "create", "--title", "Triage log " + day, "--label", "triage:log", "--body", "Daily triage log")
    for old in [i for i in items if any(x["name"] == "triage:log" for x in i["labels"] or [])]:
        gh("issue", "close", str(old["number"]))
        items.remove(old)
        closed.append(old)
    log = {"number": n, "title": "Triage log " + day, "body": "Daily triage log", "labels": [{"name": "triage:log"}],
           "milestone": None, "assignees": [], "url": url(n), "createdAt": day + "T00:00:00Z", "comments": []}
    items.append(log)
    save()
    json.dump(closed, open(closedf, "w"), indent=1)
post(log["number"], "[Riley/triage-log] %s\n\n%s\n\n<!-- crew:v1 role=researcher pass=triage-log sweep=%s applied=%d "
     "proposed=%d skipped=%d tokens=unknown -->\n%s" % (sweep, "\n".join(lines), sweep, applied, proposed, skipped, who))
status.write("done: triage %s\n" % url(log["number"]))
PY
